final_resume.summary: Proficient in Python, C++, and test automation with strong attention to detail and collaborative problem-solving skills.

bullets: Tested BLE pairing and GATT services across 12 Android and iOS devices for a wearable product line, ensuring protocol compliance and reliability.
Automated 150 firmware regression test cases using Python and pytest, reducing regression cycle time from 3 days to 1 day and enabling faster release cycles.
Logged, triaged, and tracked defects in JIRA with firmware developers during 2-week sprints, ensuring timely resolution and product quality.

projects.name: ESP32 BLE Sensor Logger
projects.description: Personal project during the career break: C firmware on ESP32 with FreeRTOS that advertises temperature readings over BLE and logs them to flash.

profile_improvement_tips: Gain hands-on experience with at least one of JavaScript or Java to meet the JD's programming language requirements more fully.
Build a project or contribute to open-source work involving distributed systems, microservices, or cloud platforms (GCP, AWS) to demonstrate system design thinking.
Pursue formal training or certifications in Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services such as Compute Engine, Cloud Storage, or Pub/Sub to align with the role's cloud-native focus.
final_resume.growth_note: Your QA and embedded systems background is strong, but the Software Engineer II role at Google Cloud expects broader full-stack development experience and familiarity with distributed systems and cloud platforms. Your 2 years of professional experience meets the minimum, but the domain shift from QA/embedded to cloud software engineering is significant; consider building projects in system design and cloud technologies to strengthen your candidacy.
